resources.string: Voxara picks the mode from the sound around you, using the measurements it already takes, and changes it slowly. When unsure, it uses Street.
Home or a quiet place: your week comes first.
Out and about: the live level comes first.
Bus, train or metro: headphones come first.
Live music: alerts vibrate twice and are never capped. Ends after 6 h, or after 20 min below 80 dBA.
At work: today\'s dose comes first.
Modes change what comes first and how Tono talks. They never lower or delay hearing alerts.
